blurb: In war, or in adventuring parties, those
who offer BLESSINGS are in high demand.
They benefit both the thaumaturgist, plus
nearby followers and allies.
Some blessings have lasting effects.
While most magic could be described as
breaking the rules of reality, the study
of CONTRAVENTION allows sorcerers to
change how rules effect one's self.
This requires ongoing magic energy to
sustain, but can be disabled at will.
DAIMONIA is the craft of using magic to
tap into the will of spirits, compelling their
influence with transformative results.
Though shunned by civilized society,
some mystics claim that their own spirit
is incomplete without this communion.
DIVINATIONS grant access to hidden
knowledge, revealing information that
there may be no other way to know.
Practicing thaumaturgists claim
that knowledge is power.
AMULETS provide reactive benefits
to their wearer, often intervening
against harm a number of times
until their magic is spent.
Some amulets have the opposite objective.
It is wise to appraise before wearing.
The ENCHANTED FEATHER can be depleted to
restore spellbooks or inscribe magic words
onto a blank scroll.
Only those who know the magic
words can inscribe with purpose.
Depleted feathers may be recharged.
Adventurers covet magical RINGS for
the passive magical benefits they
provide, with effects that range
from mild, to situational, to
extremely powerful.
Magical rings may change the world.
Sorcerers practice EVOCATION to conjure
energies and material using their minds.
Largely this is used to launch harmful
projectiles at enemies by adventurers,
many of which leave a lasting effect
that may continue to harm the target.
Mystics who practice IMPETURIA do so by
calling to the spirit of the object they
wish to manipulate, and compel it to alter
its state. Sorcerers attempting to do the
same thing with kinesis have so far been
unsuccessful.
Sorcerers practice KINESIS to move
things with their minds. While trying to
improve control and accuracy, they have
stumbled upon other innovations, but
precise manipulation remains difficult.
These weapons allow any adventurer, no
matter how mundane, to fire magical spells.
The color of the staff indicates
what kinds of spells it might contain.
The item always breaks when depleted.
A simple MEDITATION is most magicians'
first introduction to thaumaturgy.
These spells require concentration to
sustain, and will only effect the caster,
but they can be dismissed at will.
Those in ancient times who performed
MIRACULOUS FEATS are the first known
thaumaturgists. Casting immediately
performs a single wonderous action.
It is taught that aligning one's self with
great purpose will yield these powers.
The most commonly practiced of the
mystic's arts, PSIANIMUS is the craft
of using magic to alter the mind of a
living (or unliving) target.
The effects are usually temporary,
otherwise its reputation might differ.
Considered a forbidden and dark art by
the church, SARKOMANCY is the craft of
using magic to manipulate the body,
usually against unwilling targets.
Uses of this magic to benefit one's
own body are said to only be rumors.
A scroll can be invoked by any adventurer
to spend its stored spell, however it is
immediately consumed upon use.
Some spells can only be found on scrolls.
Blank scrolls may later be inscribed,
with the right tools and knowledge.
Sometimes magic is needed that does
not simply hurl one force at another.
The study of TEMULTURGY is specialized
toward disrupting an object's structure.
So far sorcerers haven't figured out
how to practice this on living targets.
With its incredible destructive potential
the ARCHON SCEPTER is fed by the wielder's
surrendered memories.
Those found wielding one usually claim
they own it by birthright. Others cannot
recall where they obtained it.
Sorcerers often carry raw elemental
manifestations as SOURCE FOCI, improving
their connection to magical energies.
Each one emits a glow, and readily
provides a channel for rapid evocation
when needed for dealing with threats.
Casting out darkness wherever they go,
devout thaumaturgists wield HOLY SYMBOLS.
Dedicating a prayer with one of these in
hand provides its blessing to any willing
soul when the magical chant concludes.
Taking more time improves the effect.
DARK ICONS are used by mystics to
channel their magical arts to lay
curses against their enemies.
Each one provides its own malus that
the caster invokes with whispers,
hindering enemies from some distance.
While mundane on their own, MUSICAL
INSTRUMENTS channel magic from the
musician's spirit, uplifting friends
who are present to hear it.
When played with dedication and care,
songs hang in the air for a while.
JEWELS are valuable and alluring to
most intelligent creatures, serving
as fine payment for loyal followers.
Many jewelers embed their gemstones
in gold, enhancing their beauty
in addition to their value.
Through ambition, sorcerors may be
inspired by evocation spells, gaining
access to entirely new powers.
ASCENDED EVOCATION spells open up new
possibilities to skilled evokers.
Sorcerers who practice contravention
aren't shy about breaking the rules.
It's second-nature, then, to find the
barriers which prevent access to
ASCENDED CONTRAVENTION spells and
shatter them to discover new magic.
In sorcery, mind-over-matter is perhaps
best expressed through kinesis, wielding
direct control over the physical realm
with the will alone. Those who set their
minds to it are inspired with ASCENDED
KINESIS spells to practice.
The art of deconstruction is under-
appreciated, except by dedicated
thaumaturgists. By shattering the
fundamental principles of spellcasting
itself, sorcerers can break new ground
uncovering ASCENDED TEMULTURGY spells.
Those who provide blessings hunger to be
of even greater help. Thaumaturgists
seeking for greater ways to give, with
devotion, may be blessed with
ASCENDED BLESSINGS, where they may
continue their benevolent practice.
Thaumaturgists who practice divination
know that seeking knowledge is a sacred
calling. With sincere pursuit,
one can access greater wisdom
with ASCENDED DIVINATION spells,
leading to greater knowledge.
Using thaumaturgy to perform wonders
is a practice that can improve with
faithful pursuit. Those who are wholly
committed may be trusted with even
more powerful ASCENDED MIRACULOUS FEATS
to exercise as they perform their work.
Meditations provide acess to great
power to thaumaturgists through
concentration and dedication.
With greater focus, the devout
may reveal ASCENDED MEDITATIONS,
which further elevates them.
The strengths and weaknesses of the
flesh are known better to none than
sarkomancers. These mystics may pursue
their grim ideas with dedication and
discover an ASCENDED SARKOMANCY spell
to wield, often with grotesque results.
The paradox of free will, and magic
that can be used to control it, is the.
specialty of psianimus-practicing mystics.
Those who enjoy this conundrum may
obsess their way into uncovering
ASCENDED PSIANIMUS spells to ponder.
Wise mystics know that greater
intelligence can be found in the spirit
realm, coaxed forth with daimonia magic.
In pursuit of these minds,
ASCENDED DAIMONIA spells give them even
greater links to these personalities.
The most academic of the mystic arts,
practitioners of impeturia are nothing
if not practical. Through creative
pursuit, ASCENDED IMPETURIAL spells
may be revealed, granting even more tools
to wield in pursuit of magic advancement.
